description: Detect the source language of a piece of text. Returns ranked language candidates with confidence.
name: libretranslate_detect_language

candidates.description: Ranked language candidates with confidence scores

found.description: Present and true on an answer; a miss is the found:false branch.

oneOf.description: A miss or an unavailable upstream: found:false with a reason and a hint (the shape check-found-false-schemas.mjs expects).

title: Libretranslate Detect Language
